contracts.action: Row click no longer toggles the finding when text is selected (window.getSelection() non-empty)
contracts.equivalent_path: The same row onClick handler (reconcile-dialog.tsx:211-219) and the checkbox's onChange (reconcile-dialog.tsx:230), both calling setFixing.
contracts.before_after: Before: any click on the row other than on the input toggled it, including the click that ends a drag-select. After: that click returns early when a selection exists. A plain click collapses any prior selection on mousedown, so toString() is empty and the toggle still runs. A double-click toggles once, because the second click sees the selected word.
contracts.visible_effect: Dragging over a file name to copy it leaves the row ticked or unticked as it was. A plain click still toggles the checkbox, dimming, count and button label.
contracts.failure_mode: No async call is involved. getSelection() can return null, which the optional chaining handles by falling through to the toggle.
